notes.title: Rustler - Early Access Release and Loyalty Discount
notes.notes:
Dear all!
We are happy to announce the launch of the Early Access version of Rustler!

Owners of this game will get the 25% Loyalty DISCOUNT when buying Rustler!
 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/844260][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944205/fa8c36f50a21edae36bee4e0f8a1dab3d046ec0a.png[/img][/url]

Experience feudal injustice, witch-hunting and join big tournaments. Meet valiant, yet incredibly stupid knights. Complete a wide variety of twisted missions and quests... or don’t give a damn about the plot and bring mayhem in the villages and cities. Choose to go on foot or by a stolen horse. Fight with a sword or pick a fancy automatic crossbow. All that spiced up with an inappropriate Monty Python inspired sense of humor!

There's no time to wait - discount is available only till February 24th! Buy Rustler now and ride Your Horse! 🐴

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844260

notes.title: Radio Commander DLC - Squad Management - Sneak Peak video and release date!
notes.notes:
Exciting news for all current and future Radio Commander players!

Our new[b] Squad Management DLC[/b] receives an official release date:[b] 10.04.2020![/b]
The release price will be set at: [b]5$[/b]

If you are asking yourself, “What new features can I expect for just five bucks?”, take a look at the in depth Developer Sneak Peak which has been published our new official [b]YouTube channel[/b].

[previewyoutube=4rxLwSSG7vw;full][/previewyoutube]

We would love to know your thoughts on the planned release. Hop onto Radio Commander [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/Sdqmb2H]Discord[/url] or [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/RadioCommander/]subReddit[/url] and share them with us. The same goes with any questions you might have.


In the mean time, help us spread the word Commanders :)

notes.title: Radio Commander has a release date!
notes.notes:
Hello Radio Commanders!

Thanks to your support, we are approaching the end of the project! Radio Commander will be officially released on October 10th 2019! We will send all the codes and all the rewards shortly after.

Thank you very much for your patience and we hope that you'll enjoy what we have prepared for you.

Best regards! RC crew

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33336099/c903e66090bb2a029ae6f9f2dd522f3b505b5f0c.png[/img]

PS. Great guys from Jutsu Games/Games Operators, creators of 911 Operator, are back with 112 Operator! We think you might be interested and become a backer of their new game.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/112-operator-sequel-to-911-operator]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/112-operator-sequel-to-911-operator[/url]

notes.title: DEMO update and explanatory video!
notes.notes:
We want to announce that all the clients have been updated to stable BETA version 0.724.

Therefore, all the backers that received demo keys and other key-holders can now play the latest version of Radio Commander.

This version includes e.g.
-difficulty settings
-replay mode
-voice recognition
-new map tools
-missions 1-5 (3-5 with placeholder VOs)
-many different features
-some bugs (probably)

We are approx. 2 months before the release and things are going quite good :)

Also, we've made an explanatory video. Enjoy!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8PeQy9kvSw

BR!
Jacob
